title: Soukuu no Tsubasa: Gotha World
overview:
A world where continents float on a sea of clouds and ships dance among them. Now, on the stage of the vast sky, the curtain rises on a fierce battle!

Packed with unique new features and new systems!

Soukuu no Tsubasa: Gotha World is a 3D tactical simulation of aerial warfare. Command your squadron of flying ships and fighters, issuing orders to move, attack, check damage reports and review the mission plan, then watch the battle unfold in 3D above the clouds.

The Personal Time System gives each unit its own clock, blending the strengths of turn-based and real-time play. In combat you freely choose between several weapons, and your pilots grow with experience, so how you raise them shapes the course of the war. Animated story scenes with a full voice cast carry the tale between battles.

- 3D tactical aerial combat
- Personal Time System for unit actions
- Multiple selectable weapons per attack
- Pilot growth with character-raising elements
- Animated movie scenes
- 1-2 players, two discs

大陸が雲海に浮かび、船が雲間を舞う世界。壮大な大空を舞台に今、熾烈な戦いの幕が切って落とされる！

独自の新機能・新システムを満載！
